title: RRG Monitor universe data
description: Column-oriented, playhead-indexable snapshot of one RRG universe. Every per-security array and every benchmark_series array is aligned 1:1 with `dates` (same length, ascending). The front-end indexes all views by a single time cursor into `dates`. FROZEN v1.0 (Phase 0, 2026-07-25).

id.description: Slug matching the universes.yaml key and the file name (<id>.json).

label.description: Human-readable universe name for the UI.

benchmark.description: Ticker the RS metrics are computed against.

generated_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the export run.

params.description: The JdK RS parameters used, echoed for transparency / the methodology panel.

weeks.description: Total weekly bars pulled for the computation.

tail.description: Number of most-recent weeks retained in `dates` / arrays (the visible window).

rs_ratio_ema.description: EMA span used to normalize the RS line (default 52).

dates.description: Weekly dates, ascending, ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Length T. The shared x-axis for every view.

benchmark_series.description: Context series for the benchmark, driving the shared-time-axis strip.

close.description: Benchmark close price, aligned to `dates` (length T).

regime.description: Market regime label per week, aligned to `dates` (length T). Drives the regime band behind the price strip.

securities.description: One entry per plotted security. Every metric array is aligned to `dates` (length T).

rs_ratio.description: JdK RS-Ratio, centered near 100. Length T.

rs_momentum.description: JdK RS-Momentum, centered near 100. Length T.

quadrant.description: Quadrant label per week, aligned to `dates` (length T). The shared color key across all views.
